Autoimmune Hepatitis Mouse Model Liver Immune Cell Atlas

Single-cell transcriptomic and TCR resource for a spontaneous mouse model of autoimmune hepatitis.

Study overview

Autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) is characterized by persistent sterile hepatic inflammation and progressive fibrosis, yet treatment relies on broad immunosuppression. The cellular mechanisms sustaining pathogenic autoreactive T-cell responses in the liver remain poorly defined, partly because few experimental models reproduce spontaneous disease progression. In this study, we introduced mice deficient in DNase II and the type I interferon receptor (Dnase2a−/− Ifnar1−/−) as a spontaneous model of type 1 autoimmune hepatitis recapitulating key features of human disease, including interface hepatitis, elevated ALT, progressive fibrosis, antinuclear antibodies, and hypergammaglobulinemia. Paired single-cell RNA sequencing and T-cell receptor sequencing were used to characterize the liver immune-cell landscape and connect T-cell transcriptional states with clonotype expansion.

    Study design

    From spontaneous liver inflammation to a navigable immune-cell atlas

    The atlas accompanies a study of a spontaneous autoimmune-hepatitis-like mouse model and connects broad immune remodeling with focused myeloid, T-cell, and TCR analyses.

    01

    Mouse model

    AIH model (DKO) and Control (Het) mice provide the biological comparison.

    →
    02

    Liver immune profiling

    Single-cell RNA sequencing maps immune populations and transcriptional states.

    →
    03

    Focused resolution

    Monocyte/macrophage and T-cell subsets are reanalyzed at higher resolution.

    →
    04

    TCR context

    Activated CD8 states are linked to clonal expansion and paired CDR3 sequences.

    Biological question

    How does chronic innate immune activation reshape the liver immune compartment and sustain pathogenic T-cell responses?

    The atlas is designed as an extension of the manuscript: readers can move beyond the figures, search their own genes of interest, compare conditions, and locate expanded T-cell clonotypes within the activated-CD8 landscape.

    Methods & data

    Transparent data scope and interpretation

    Version 1 is liver-only and preserves the analyzed UMAP coordinates and reviewed working annotations from each source object.

    Data scope

    Liver immune cells only

    Spleen cells present in some source objects are excluded from every atlas level shown here.

    Expression

    Normalized RNA data

    FeaturePlots and summaries use the Seurat RNA assay data layer. They are descriptive visualizations, not significance tests.

    Embeddings

    Preserved source UMAPs

    Each level is a separately analyzed dataset with its own frozen UMAP. Moving deeper changes resolution rather than filtering the parent embedding.

    Gene summaries

    Condition-aware expression

    Mean normalized expression and the percentage of expressing cells are shown separately for Het and DKO. Cell-level error bars are descriptive and do not represent variation between animals.

    TCR

    Sample-aware clones

    The private preview defines displayed clones by biological sample and paired amino-acid CDR3 identity.

    Release status

    Private review build

    Annotations, public sample labels, downloadable matrices, and the final clonotype release remain subject to manuscript sign-off.
